### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Clinical impact of AI in drug discovery remains unproven](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/so-how-ai-drug-discovery-doing-really)** — *Science*
  * An analysis of AI applications in biopharma concludes that empirical evidence for clinically relevant outcomes remains thin, reflecting an absence of evidence rather than definitive proof of failure.
  * Current AI methodologies show utility in benchmarked computational tasks, but their ability to improve strategic decision-making, such as disease target selection, has not yet translated into clinical efficacy.

* **[HCAR1 regulatory variants link schizophrenia genomics to tumor resistance](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.04.26359703)** — *medRxiv*
  * Cross-trait genome-wide association studies revealed that solid tumors rely on host expression of the lactate receptor HCAR1 to form an immunosuppressive lactate shield via macrophage recruitment.
  * Schizophrenia cohorts display high structural variation at the HCAR1 3′ regulatory enhancer, disrupting receptor expression and conferring non-lifestyle-related genetic resistance to solid tumors.

* **[RNF5 mechanism identified in acute lung injury](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42575990/)** — *PubMed*
  * Preclinical research demonstrates that ring finger protein 5 (RNF5) promotes acute lung injury through cytosol translocation of heat shock protein family A member 5 (HSPA5).
  * RNF5-mediated translocation triggers downstream protein kinase RNA-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase (PERK) activation, establishing a potential target for therapeutic intervention.

* **[Biotech]** **[MAdCAM-1/IL-22 bispecific (7A2-IgG4-IL22) shows targeted mucosal healing in IBD models](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.07.26359969)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Engineered a human IgG4 bispecific combining an anti-MAdCAM-1 scFv with IL-22 cargo to direct anti-inflammatory activity and epithelial repair locally to the gastrointestinal tract.
  * Inhibited T-cell activation, expansion, and secretion of IFNγ and TNF, while triggering localized STAT3-mediated mucosal restoration without systemic immunosuppression.

* **[Decade-long persistence of CD19 CAR T cells confirmed in lymphoma patients](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04578-1)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Longitudinal monitoring demonstrated functional CD19 CAR T-cell detection at least 10 years post-infusion in patients with B-cell lymphoma.
  * Single-cell phenotyping revealed a predominant double-negative (CD4⁻CD8⁻) activated effector-memory-like population driving long-term immune surveillance.

* **[Botanical formulation CDD-2101 restores gut motility by restructuring specific microbial guilds](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.08.26359996)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Clinical trial integrated with genome-resolved metagenomics demonstrated that CDD-2101 selectively suppresses the pathobiont C1B guild within the Two Competing Guilds architecture in functional constipation.
  * Metabolomic profiling confirmed multi-receptor-mediated activation of gut motility across three independent cohorts under an active US FDA IND program.

* **[Plasma p-tau217 interacts with age to modify cognitive decline trajectory in AD](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.08.26359816)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Analysis of 3,741 memory-clinic patients over up to 28 years of follow-up established a significant age-by-p-tau217 interaction (p = 9.81 × 10⁻⁷) on Clinical Dementia Rating progression.
  * Results indicate prognostic thresholds for plasma p-tau217 in trial enrichment must be adjusted for patient chronological age.

* **[Multimodal speech composites improve MCI and early cognitive impairment detection](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.07.26359965)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Constructed ten multimodal composites spanning acoustics, semantics, and narrative recall to differentiate normal aging, subjective cognitive impairment (SCI), and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from a single brief task.
  * Retrieval Fidelity uniquely separated SCI from cognitively normal controls, while non-overlapping composites identified MCI, offering sensitive tools for clinical trial stratification.

* **[25-year prion disease natural history dataset established to empower antisense and RNAi trial designs](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.07.26359973)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Aggregated published literature from 2000–2024 to map symptomatic disease milestones, akinetic mutism timelines, and survival distributions in prion disease.
  * Establishes quantitative baseline metrics to optimize power calculations and control arms for upcoming prion protein-lowering clinical trials.

* **[Genomically Adjusted Radiation Dose (GARD) stratifies radiosensitivity in pediatric CNS tumors](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.09.26359976)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Retrospective cohort study in 246 pediatric patients (high-grade glioma, medulloblastoma, ependymoma) validated GARD integration of gene expression with physical radiation dose.
  * Demonstrated that biological radiation dose predicts clinical outcomes, supporting personalized dosing strategies to minimize long-term pediatric neurotoxicity.

* **[SWCNT biosensor array identifies ALS serum protein corona signatures](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.08.26354966)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Combined a 12-chirality single-walled carbon nanotube array with autoencoding neural networks to capture time-resolved serum protein-nanoparticle interaction dynamics.
  * Achieved liquid-biopsy discrimination between ALS patients (n = 20) and matched controls (n = 19).

* **[A-to-I RNA editing clusters in nephrotic syndrome link to renal function](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.08.26359884)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Profiled single-site and cluster A-to-I RNA editing in 215 patients from the NEPTUNE network with focal segmental glomerulosclerosis or minimal change disease.
  * Identified tissue-specific editing alterations associated with eGFR, proteinuria, and interferon-stimulated gene scores.

* **[Meta-analysis quantifies structural reversal in ATTR cardiac amyloidosis under targeted therapies](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.07.26359992)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Meta-analysis across 18 studies (11 RCTs) evaluated the effects of TTR stabilizers and RNA-silencing therapies on echocardiographic parameters in ATTR-CM.
  * Demonstrated significant pooled improvements in global longitudinal strain, interventricular septal thickness, and left ventricular mass.

* **[Heterozygous TECTB variants implicated in autosomal dominant non-syndromic hearing loss](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.08.13.25333146)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Identified p.Cys225Tyr and p.Arg285Cys missense variants in β-tectorin (TECTB) directly affecting the conserved zona pellucida domain.
  * A Tectb-C225Y knock-in mouse model confirmed disruption of tectorial membrane matrix structure and impairment of auditory sensitivity.

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **[Sionna Therapeutics drops 92% as cystic fibrosis drug fails Phase 2 trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sionna-cystic-fibrosis-drug-study-results-vertex-trikafta/827431/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * SION-719 failed to hit its primary endpoint in a Phase 2 trial evaluating its additive effect when combined with Vertex's Trikafta in patients with cystic fibrosis.
  * The combination regimen yielded no statistically significant placebo-adjusted change in sweat chloride levels compared to Trikafta monotherapy.
  * Sionna announced capital preservation measures while evaluating remaining clinical pipeline programs; Vertex shares rose 7% following the news.

* **[Biotech]** **[Silence Therapeutics reports positive Phase 2 SANRECO results for divesiran in polycythemia vera](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/10/silence-polycythemia-vera-trial-results-divesiran-takeda-rusfertide/)** — *STAT / X / Twitter*
  * Mid-stage SANRECO clinical trial results for divesiran, an siRNA therapeutic, met its primary endpoint with an 88% clinical response rate compared to 19% for placebo in polycythemia vera patients.
  * The disease-modifying efficacy data position divesiran as a clinical rival to Takeda's injectable peptide mimetic rusfertide in the rare blood cancer space.

* **[Biomarker analysis reveals mechanism of durable response in MSS pancreatic cancer trial](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.06.26359422)** — *bioRxiv*
  * Longitudinal profiling from a Phase 2 study evaluating nivolumab, ipilimumab, and radiation in pretreated metastatic microsatellite stable (MSS) pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma identified cellular drivers of complete response.
  * Single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomic tracking of a 4-year durable complete responder showed a shift in tumor-infiltrating CD8⁺ T cell clonotypes from GZMK⁺ states into exhausted, tumor-reactive functional phenotypes.

* **[Non-invasive vibrotactile fingertip stimulation attenuates subthalamic nucleus beta power in Parkinson's disease](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.09.26356470)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * In a 12-patient pilot trial in OFF-medication/OFF-DBS states, rapidly varying sequences of fingertip stimulation significantly suppressed pathologically elevated beta-band local field potentials in the subthalamic nucleus.

* **[Biotech]** **[Onconova prepares to advance lead candidate into Phase 1 clinical testing](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2086756484801511427)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Onconova Therapeutics is slated to enter Phase 1 trial evaluation next month for its primary clinical asset.

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **[Tenax Therapeutics' levosimendan fails pivotal heart failure trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/10/tenax-heart-failure-drug-trail-failure-levosimendan-ph-hfpef/)** — *STAT*
  * Levosimendan missed its primary endpoint in a pivotal trial evaluating the agent in patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (PH-HFpEF).
  * The failure represents a major setback for Tenax's lead cardiovascular pipeline asset.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Roche's obinutuzumab β slashes NMOSD relapse risk by 93% in Phase 3 trial](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04583-4)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Phase 3 randomized controlled trial in aquaporin-4 antibody-positive (AQP4-IgG⁺) neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder demonstrated a 93.1% relative risk reduction in relapses versus placebo.
  * Treatment significantly improved clinical and MRI outcomes, with zero relapses observed during extended open-label follow-up.

* **[Biotech]** **[MoonLake Immunotherapeutics meets all primary and secondary endpoints in Phase 3 IZAR-1 trial of sonelokimab](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2086772850501812485)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Phase 3 IZAR-1 trial evaluating 60 mg sonelokimab in bio-naive psoriatic arthritis met its primary endpoint and all secondary clinical endpoints at Week 16.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Grifols completes last patient visit in Phase 3 SPARTA trial of Prolastin-C](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2086773764054777959)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Reached Last Patient Last Visit in the pivotal SPARTA trial evaluating Prolastin-C in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency-related emphysema, with topline outcomes expected by year-end.

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA rejects ITM Radiopharma's targeted radiopharmaceutical therapy](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/10/itm-radiopharma-fda-rejection/)** — *STAT*
  * The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter rejecting ITM Radiopharma's therapeutic radiopharmaceutical candidate due to manufacturing and quality compliance issues.
  * The decision halts a potential direct commercial competitor to Novartis's established radioligand oncology portfolio.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi experiences Pompe disease drug shortages following FDA warning](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/10/sanofi-drug-shortage-jazz-pharma-deal/)** — *STAT*
  * Sanofi is facing supply shortages for two enzyme replacement therapies used to treat Pompe disease.
  * The supply constraints follow an FDA warning letter highlighting manufacturing quality deficiencies at a key production facility.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Takeda secures landmark approval for first-in-class orexin agonist oveporexton](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00135-0)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery / PubMed*
  * Regulators approved oveporexton (Orzeyful), an oral first-in-class orexin receptor agonist, for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1, addressing underlying orexin deficiency.
  * The approval represents the first mechanism-targeted disease-modifying therapy validated for narcolepsy pathophysiology and sleep disorders.

### Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[Jazz Pharmaceuticals acquires Actio Biosciences for up to $1.3B](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/jazz-actio-acquisition-deal-rare-neurological-epilepsy/827409/)** — *BioPharma Dive / X / Twitter*
  * Jazz will pay $820 million up front plus up to $500 million in clinical, regulatory, and commercial milestones in a deal valued at up to $1.32B to acquire Actio Biosciences.
  * Actio's lead program is a targeted therapy for rare genetic epilepsies driven by mutations in the KCNT1 gene.
  * Actio will spin out its early-stage Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease ion channel program into a newly funded entity, with Jazz retaining a minority equity stake.

* **[Biotech]** **[Scribe Therapeutics prices IPO to advance epigenetic gene silencing platform](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/scribe-gene-editing-ipo-benjamin-oakes-epigenetic-pcsk9/827432/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * UC Berkeley spinout Scribe Therapeutics priced its initial public offering, marking the first gene-editing biotech IPO in over two years.
  * Scribe's platform focuses on CRISPR-based epigenetic editing to transiently switch off target genes, led by a clinical-stage PCSK9 program for hypercholesterolemia.

* **[Biotech]** **[NextCure closes $500M PIPE financing with healthcare syndicate](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2086772525363519954)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Secured $500M in PIPE funding from investors including Venrock, General Atlantic, Blackstone Multi-Asset Investing, RTW Investments, Eventide, BB Biotech, Wellington, and Janus Henderson.

* **[Biotech]** **[Replimune prices $150M public offering](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2086785084007333966)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Priced an underwritten public offering of common stock valued at $150M at $12.06 per share.

* **[Biotech]** **[Innate Pharma maintains financing commitment for Tellomak-3](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2086730312965390597)** — *X / Twitter*
  * Innate Pharma remains obligated to finance the Tellomak-3 program under a $75M funding structure.

### Public Health & Policy

* **[Executive order directs review of US childhood immunization schedule](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/10/trump-return-to-vaccine-policy-executive-order/)** — *STAT*
  * A newly issued executive order mandates a federal evaluation of established childhood vaccination schedules.
  * The order signals a renewed focus on national vaccine policy and regulatory oversight frameworks.

* **[China tightens regulatory oversight for investigator-initiated clinical trials](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/10/china-biotech-new-scrutiny-investigator-initiated-trials/)** — *STAT*
  * Chinese health authorities have enacted stricter compliance standards and oversight mechanisms for investigator-initiated trials.
  * The policy changes impact domestic biotech development velocity as well as international clinical research collaborations relying on Chinese clinical sites.

* **[Ebola outbreak response strategies require broadening beyond Zaire strain](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/10/ebola-outbreak-zaire-ebolavirus-bundibugyo-diagnostics-therapeutics/)** — *STAT / Nature Medicine*
  * Phylogenetic sequencing of 22 viral genomes from the active Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda established that the outbreak stems from a novel, independent Bundibugyo virus zoonotic spillover event.
  * Global public health experts caution that infectious disease preparedness optimized exclusively for Zaire ebolavirus leaves healthcare systems exposed, advocating for flexible diagnostic panels and pan-ebolavirus therapeutic platforms.

* **[Two-time antenatal STI screening proven cost-effective for reducing preterm birth in South Africa](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.08.26360003)** — *Papers & Preprints*
  * Decision-analytic modeling of the Philani Ndiphile trial demonstrated that two-time antenatal screening for *C. trachomatis*, *N. gonorrhoeae*, and *T. vaginalis* significantly reduced preterm birth, low birthweight, and DALYs compared to standard syndromic management.

* **[Policy framework outlines targeted actions for global access to novel diabetes drugs](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04579-0)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Proposes regulatory, pricing, and health-system intervention frameworks to address systemic access disparities for newer diabetes medication classes across low- and middle-income countries.

**Worth watching:** Radiopharmaceutical CMC and regulatory bottlenecks, as FDA rejections and complex manufacturing requirements create operational friction across emerging radioligand platforms.

- Biology & Health
    - [The Unexpected Muscle Effect of… Omega-3 Fats?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r__LqzSrU0c) -- Physionic
        - Dietary omega-3 fatty acid supplementation increases the rate of muscle protein synthesis (MPS) in older adults.
        - Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids augment the anabolic muscle protein response to hyperaminoacidemia and hyperinsulinemia in healthy young, middle-aged, and older adults.
        - Supplementation leads to the incorporation of omega-3 fatty acids into human skeletal muscle sarcolemmal and mitochondrial membranes, altering mitochondrial membrane composition and respiration kinetics.
        - Combining fish oil supplementation with strength training enhances overall anabolic and physical performance adaptations in elderly populations.
    - [Are You Automating a Broken System?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/yRXAFdHBtzY) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Stephanie Davis discusses AI disruption, startup strategy, and product strategy within the digital health and healthtech sectors.
        - Highlights that simply automating inefficient or broken workflows does not constitute genuine healthcare innovation.
        - Emphasizes the need for strategic technology implementation that addresses underlying system workflows rather than digitizing flawed processes.
